schema.encoding: plain JSON, one combined file for every symbol (fetch once client-side, look up by symbol)

event.date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD (ex-date for corporate actions, meeting date for board meetings)
event.type: dividend | bonus | split | rights | buyback | demerger | corporateAction | boardMeeting
event.title: human-readable summary as published by NSE
event.recordDate: ISO date or null (corporate actions only)

schema.note: Each symbol's list is trimmed to the last 10 days plus any future-dated events on every publish run; a symbol with nothing in that window still has a key with an empty array. A separate, never-trimmed archive of every event ever seen lives at internal/events_archive/events.jsonl — not fetched by the app, not part of this schema.
